title: Chapter 42 Tool Man
content:
Chapter 42 Tool Man

That day, she was as beautiful as a lotus emerging from the water, intoxicating!

That day, he galloped on the battlefield, guarding his beloved girl!

…

That day, he was on the top of the city, surrounded by enemies.

The past is vivid, making people sigh!

Zhao Bangde's biggest dream is to be free one day and find the person who haunts him.

So, he worked hard to complete every task and strive to get a perfect evaluation for every task!

If he completes one more task, he will be free!

The so-called hometown is more timid, which makes him a little uneasy.

His heart is full of countless questions:

Is Caiyi still alive?

Even if she is alive, how should he find her?

After all, the Vlandia continent is too big.

Thinking about it, time flies!

In the evening, another day passed, and Wang Shuo also completed the two tasks issued by Zhao Bangde.

"Old Zhao, I have completed the two tasks you issued to me!"

After receiving the system prompt, Wang Shuo immediately found Zhao Bangde.

"Well, not bad, it's pretty fast! This is a reward for you."

[Horse card +1, riding skill book +1, military merit points +50. ]

[Void positioning stone +1, military merit points +200. ]

Wang Shuo immediately took out the horse card and silently said "summon" in his heart.

A sturdy red warhorse appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

He then took out the "Riding Skill Book" and clicked to learn.

[Riding: Current level 1, proficiency 0/100. ]

After learning riding, Wang Shuo felt that he had a lot more knowledge about riding in his mind, as if he had mastered this skill for a long time.

Wang Shuo kicked his right foot, jumped up, rode on the horse's back, and then galloped happily on the Gobi Desert.

After running for a long time, he returned to the camp with satisfaction.

"Old Zhao, how do I use this Void Positioning Stone?"

"You just need to embed this Void Positioning Stone into the base camp, and then enter the coordinates of your Void Battlefield Portal, and that's it."

It sounds simple. Wang Shuo vaguely remembers that his Void Battlefield Portal is also a string similar to his ID. After entering it, it is connected to the transmission channel.

Now you can directly teleport from the territory to the Yellow Wind Valley Camp.

"Old Zhao, what do you think I should exchange?"

In the past two days, Wang Shuo has obtained more than 500 military merit points by constantly killing skeleton soldiers and accepting cycle tasks.

"Your current military merit points are still too few." Zhao Bangde pondered for a while, and then asked: "Have you thought about what path you will take in the future?"

Wang Shuo thought for a while, confused, looked at Zhao Bangde's pretentious look, and said with a smile: "Old Zhao, don't keep me in suspense, tell me about it."

Seeing Wang Shuo's anxious look, Zhao Bangde smiled and said slowly: "Every novice player, in addition to the life profession, can also choose a combat profession, mainly swordsman, cavalry, archer, counselor, ranger, boxer, assassin, priest..."

There are many types of combat professions. After passing the novice village trial in the later stage, players will be divided into two categories. One is the lord player, who mainly needs to build a territory and develop the army.

The other type of players lost the lord qualification and became refugees. They can choose to become a lord or mercenary, etc., and there are many development directions.

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided that if he wanted to achieve something in this world, he had to become a lord.

But to be a lord who plans and strategizes, or to be a lord who gallops on the battlefield.

Wang Shuo was in a dilemma.

But soon, Wang Shuo made a decision. No matter which one, he must improve his basic strength.

"What kind of weapon do you like?"

Wang Shuo didn't have any special preference. Thinking that he had just obtained a warhorse, and he also had a blueprint of "Flame Spear".

Maybe becoming a cavalryman is a good choice.

"Lance!"

"Well, in that case, then work hard to become a general!"

"General?"

"Yes, as long as the strength attribute reaches 30, the level reaches level 20, and you get a general transfer certificate, you can transfer to a general."

Wang Shuo couldn't help but yearn for it!

"But before that, you have to become a cavalryman first. From now on, you can develop your own cavalry team."

"How can I become a cavalryman? Where can I recruit people?"

"I have it now!"

Zhao Bangde opened the exchange list.

There are many character lists inside.

"These are all system tools that players can recruit. They have different qualifications, skills, and basic attributes, so the prices are naturally different."

"However, these are tools with sealed souls. They will only follow their instincts and obey orders. If you want them to restore their original appearance, you only need to give them soul crystals."

"So you also need soul crystals?"

"Hehe, yes, but ordinary soul crystals are no longer useful to me."

Wang Shuo looked at the price and couldn't help but be amazed. He clicked on the cheapest one.

[ID:3334 Philomena]

[Level: Level 2]

[Strength: 3]

[Constitution: 5]

[Agility: 2]

[Energy: 9]

[Evaluation: A thin little girl, powerless]

[Recruitment price: 150 military merit points. ]

Wang Shuo was speechless. This price was too black.

Before recruiting, you can only see the basic attributes, and other information is not available.

But with Zhao Bangde here, this is not a problem.

"Can the price be negotiated?"

"I have adjusted it to the lowest price within my scope of responsibility."

"You can't just look at the price, you still have to choose those with good growth and high cost performance." Zhao Bangde suggested.

Wang Shuo felt like a human trafficker at this time.

These were once living people, but now they have become commodities that can be bought and sold.

Old Zhao selected ten of the most promising ones from the hundreds of candidate tools for him.

[ID: 7852 Ayub]

[Level: Level 20]

[Strength: 37]

[Constitution: 35]

[Agility: 21]

[Energy: 16]

[Evaluation: He was once a king, but later fell. ]

[Recruitment price: 10,000 military merit points. ]

…

[ID: 9536 Gong Zheng]

[Level: Level 2]

[Strength: 10]

[Physique: 8]

[Agility: 7]

[Energy: 5]

[Evaluation: Honest, hardworking, and has high growth potential. ]

[Recruitment price: 500 military merit points. ]

When Wang Shuo saw the first place Ayub, he couldn't believe that there was such a person with such high attributes.

Under normal circumstances, when I was level 20, it would be good to have half of his attributes.

And his price was like a basin of cold water, which made Wang Shuo completely give up.

After a selection, Wang Shuo spent 500 military merit points and recruited Gong Zheng.

The biggest advantage of a tool man is that he is infinitely loyal and does not need to be paid.

Compared with refugees and mercenaries, this is a good advantage, especially in the early stage of the lord, for the need for security, the tool man has more advantages.

A flash of white light passed by, and a big man with a curly beard immediately appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

He was wearing coarse cloth, tall, at least 1.8 meters tall, with broad shoulders and a round waist, and looked strong and powerful.

"Greetings, lord!" Gong Zheng's voice was a little deep and mechanical.

He looked like a fool!

Although he looked a little dull and stupid, Wang Shuo was still very happy.

This was the first little brother he had received. Chang Gui was not counted, he didn't even have a body, and he was always unreliable at critical moments!

"I must train him well!" Wang Shuo kept reminding himself in his heart.
